summary: A Docker host Mercator has not enrolled, already holding every byte of the 18GB image, beside a Rental that costs more. The Run takes the borrowed slot and is priced the whole pull anyway, because Mercator has nothing running on that machine to ask. World Truth says the machine holds the image; the offer says nothing at all, and the two are different questions. A world that answered the second from the first would hand Placement a certainty no deployment has: every provider adapter in the tree reports an unknown inventory for the machines it sells.
